entities.name: Tamni
entities.description: A young, eager human artificer on Avishkar who worked with Pia Nalaar.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Renegade Prime and quicksmith who taught Tamni and was arrested by the Consulate.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker who asked Tamni what she had seen.

entities.name: Grandmother Pashiri
entities.description: Woman seen with the Consulate who led two women toward Kujar.

events.summary: Pia guides Tamni through diagnosing a burning thopter and demonstrates her quicksmithing.
events.quote: Pia guided Tamni through diagnosing and fixing the thopter

events.summary: Tamni witnesses the Consulate arrest Pia.
events.quote: Tamni witnessed Pia being arrested by the Consulate

events.summary: Ajani Goldmane asks Tamni what she saw and reassures her that charging in would have been foolish.
events.quote: was reassured by Ajani that charging into battle unprepared would have been foolish

relations.quote: Pia guided Tamni through diagnosing and fixing the thopter
